principles: jobs.available is a notification hint, never a lease or receipt.
Use the existing signed claim path as the only execution ownership boundary.
Prefer server push when available while preserving polling/claim fallback for compatibility.
Diagnostics must redact Authorization and customer API key material.
drivers: Server B-24aa provides a long-lived runner jobs SSE stream but older servers may still behave like one-shot snapshots.
The runner control-plane helper already owns register, heartbeat, claim, and release order.
Authority CLI must stay host-neutral and provider-configured, not Codex/Claude special-cased.

options.name: sse-before-claim-with-safe-fallback
pros: Smallest behavior change: add optional wait before existing claim.
Preserves signed claim as the only ownership transfer.
Supports new long-lived server stream and old snapshot/failure paths.
cons: Does not build a full long-running runner daemon.
Still depends on server support for latency improvement.

options.name: replace-claim-loop-with-sse-owned-dispatch
cons: Treats SSE too close to authority and risks executing before claim.
Larger rewrite than needed for current correctness gap.

options.name: leave-cli-polling-only
cons: Does not consume the server job-available stream and leaves the integration gap open.

rationale: Add an authenticated runner jobs stream read as a bounded notification wait before the existing signed claim request. If the stream is unsupported, empty, malformed, or fails, the runner proceeds through the existing claim path and records only redacted fallback diagnostics.

preMortem.scenario: SSE event is mistaken for a claimed job
preMortem.trigger: Runner dispatches from jobIds in jobs.available without POST /jobs/claim
preMortem.consequence: Execution can occur without server lease ownership
preMortem.mitigation: Implementation must trigger claim only; smoke asserts claim still happens and SSE alone never sets claimedJobId.

preMortem.scenario: Secret leaks in SSE fallback diagnostics
preMortem.trigger: HTTP error includes Authorization or raw customer key text
preMortem.mitigation: Use existing redaction helpers and tests with a fake secret-bearing error body.

preMortem.scenario: Old server one-shot snapshot hangs runner
preMortem.trigger: GET /jobs/stream returns one empty event then disconnects or never sends more
preMortem.mitigation: Bound stream wait and treat empty/disconnect/non-SSE as fallback-to-claim.

preMortem.trigger: Implementation hard-codes codex/claude paths from SSE data
preMortem.mitigation: Claim envelope continues to use options.runnerProvider only.
